info.name: LogStream API
info.description: REST endpoints exposed by QueryApiServer - the bridge between the LogStream backend (gRPC + Lucene) and the React dashboard. Live Tail is not included here since it's a WebSocket connection (ws://localhost:8081), not a REST call Postman can send the same way.

request.description: Total log count, plus counts grouped by service and by level. Powers the stat cards and bar charts on the Overview and Analytics pages.
Runs a search against the Lucene index and returns matching logs. Powers the search bar on the Overview and Logs pages.
Log counts grouped into 1-minute buckets. Powers the "Log volume" line chart on the Overview and Analytics pages.
Whether an alert is active right now (more than 3 ERROR logs in the last 5 minutes), plus the current error count. Powers the alert banner and the Alerts page.
A list of past moments when an alert started firing, with the error count at that time. Powers the "Alert history" table on the Alerts page.
